page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head centred at the top in Hebrew letters. Page number at the top left. Gathering signature at the foot. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: Ad hujus formam Rabbini à quibuslibet Verbis Nomina verbalia deducunt. Talia etiam sunt שְׁנִינָה, נְגִינָה, אֲכִילָה[?] quæ vide suis locis.

מִקְרָא m. Convocatio, Exod.12.16. Item, Scriptura sa-cta, quasi Lectura dicta, quòd ab omnibus hominibus, quibus salutis suæ causâ data est, legi debeat, Neh.8.8. Plural. Constr. מִקְרֵאֵי קֹדֶשׁ Convocationes sanctitatis, id est, san-ctæ, Levit.23.2. Aff. וְעַל־מִקְרָאֵיהּ Et super convocationes cœtus[?] convocatos ejus, Jesa.4.5.

קָרַב[?] Appropinquavit, Propinquus fuit, Accef-sit, Processit, Congres-sus est: Construitur cum Præposit. ל, אֶל & interdum עַל pro אֶל usurpato. Præter. קָרַב אֵלֶיהָ Accesserat ad eam, Gen.20.4. Infinit. בִּקְרֹב עָלַי Accedentibus ad me, Psal.27.2. Imp. קְרַב עַד־הֵנָּה Accede hucusque, 2.Sam.20.16. קְרַב אֵלֶיךָ אֶל־תִּגַּשׁ בִּי Appropin-qua ad te, ne attingito me, Jes.65.5. id est, Continete, Mane in tuo loco, ne accedas ad me. Futur. וַיִּקְרַב Et accesit rex עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ ad altare, 2.Reg.16.12. עַל pro אֶל. Chald: Præt. קְרַב בַּאֲדִין Tunc accesit Nebucadnezar לְתַרְעָא ad ostium fornacis, Dan.3. v.26. עַל־חַד Accesi ad unum, Dan.7.16. קִרְבוּ Accesserunt, Da-niel.3.8. Infinit. וּכְמִקְרְבַה Secundùm appropinquare eum, Cùm appropinquaret, Dan.6. verf.20. Niph: נִקְרַב Sistere se: Præter. וְנִקְרַב Et sistet se, Exod.22.8. וּנִקְרַבְתֶּם Et accedetis, sistetis vos, Jos.7.7.14. Pih. קִרֵב Appropinquare fecit, Admovit, Applicuit: Quando-que sed rarius intransitivè, Appropinquavit: Præter. כִּי קִרְבוּ לָבוֹא Cùm appropinquaverint venire, Ezech.36. v.8. id est, Cùm prope advenerint: קִרְבוּ Applicant, Hos.7.6. Imp. וְקָרֵב אֹתָם Admove ea, Ezech.37.17. Fut. אַקְרְבֵנּוּ Accedam illum, Job.31.37. Chald. Futur. וְתִקְרַב הַמּוֹ[?]

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some Hebrew forms in the Pih. and Chaldee entries are hard to read at this resolution and are marked [?]. The running head and page number are marked [?] because the scan is faint. The reference "Jesa.4.5." and "Jes.65.5." and "Jos.7.7.14." are printed as shown. The word "cœtus" is read from a worn ligature and marked [?]. The large initial קרב is set as the headword of the entry, and "Appropinquavit" follows it.
